name: @greeneek/desktop
description: Greeneek Desktop: installable Electron shell that boots gnk web locally.
author: Mostafa Taher <mostafa.taher@example.com>

scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/verify-target.mjs linux x64 && node scripts/stage.mjs && electron-builder --project .staging/app --linux deb appimage --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && node scripts/stage.mjs && electron-builder --project .staging/app --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
